newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambia mulls six bids for ZCCM's Kansanshi mine.
newsitem.headline: Zambia mulls six bids for ZCCM's Kansanshi mine.

text.p: Zambia is considering six bids for the acquisition of a majority interest in Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines' (ZCCM) Kansanshi copper mine in north-western Zambia, the Zambia Privisation Agency (ZPA) said on Thursday.
A ZPA spokesman said one bid had been received from Anvil Mining and Majestic Resources NL of Australia, and another from Cyprus Amax NL.
First Quantam Minerals Ltd, a Vancouver listed company which is developing the Bwana Mkubwa copper mine project in Zambia's northern town of Ndola, made a third bid.
Metorex (Properties) Ltd, Randex Ltd, and Afri-ore Ltd made one bid while Reunion Mining Plc and Woolwich International Holdings Ltd put in separate bids.
"Bidders have offered a mix of up-front cash payments, exploration, feasibility and development commitments, and a retained interest in the project for ZCCM," the spokesman said.
"Their bids are being considered by ZPA, ZCCM and their advisors and a further announcement is expected to be made in the near future," the spokesman added.
